facts.fact: The SAPS Service Delivery Improvement Plan in the 2025/26 Annual Performance Plan gives as baseline that 68% (789 of 1 160) of police stations sent SMS bundles giving complainants feedback on a case docket through the ICDMS functionality, under National Instruction 13 of 2017 on case docket management, with a target of 68% (796 of 1 170); the table column is headed baseline year 2023/2024, and the figure counts stations using this ICDMS function, not stations registering dockets.

The SAPS Annual Performance Plan 2025/26, tabled 4 April 2025, lists among its information systems deliverables for 2025 to 2030 the enhancement of case docket management, for case workflow, user profiles, audit trails and keeping complainants informed, with a 2025/26 deliverable of 50% functionality integration; the system is not named in that table.
facts.system: case docket management (ICDMS elsewhere in the plan)

facts.fact: The SAPS Annual Performance Plan 2025/26, tabled 4 April 2025, carries the case docket management enhancement as SAPS's own information systems deliverable and governs ICDMS use by SAPS National Instruction 13 of 2017; it names dependence on third parties such as SITA as a risk.

The SAPS Annual Performance Plan 2025/26 funds its IS/ICT deliverables from Programme 1 of Vote 28, with R2,998 billion for Technology Management Services and R2 863,0 million for computer services in 2025/26; no budget line names the case docket system.
